# Serendevity

> Serendevity is a software consulting company based in Mississauga, Ontario (Greater Toronto Area), serving clients across Canada and worldwide. We design, build and support custom software with a small senior-only team. Our philosophy: "Good. Cheap. Fast. — you pick any two," and we will be honest about the third.

## What we do

- **Web applications** — SaaS platforms, dashboards, portals, internal tools. Boringly reliable.
- **Mobile apps** — iOS, Android and progressive web apps.
- **APIs & integrations** — connecting payments, CRMs, logistics and legacy systems.
- **Cloud, DevOps & infrastructure** — deployments, monitoring, cost-managed cloud.
- **AI & data** — practical ML and LLM integrations: assistants, automation, retrieval over your documents.
- **Team augmentation** — senior engineers plugged into your team: architecture reviews, rescue missions, long-term support.

## How we work

1. **Listen** — questions before answers.
2. **Map** — a short, readable plan with phases and timelines in plain language.
3. **Build** — small iterations with working software and demos every couple of weeks.
4. **Ship** — deployed, monitored, documented, handed over.
5. **Support** — we stay on speed dial; an actual human answers.

## Key facts

- Location: Mississauga, ON, Canada (Greater Toronto Area). Remote-first.
- Contact: contact@serendevity.com — we reply within one business day.
- No blog. No newsletter. No tracking pixels. Pure static site.
- Domain: https://serendevity.com (apex canonical; www redirects to apex).
